rules: FOLD 1.1 is within the approved compatibility target for this tranche.
A 2D rectangular single-sheet graph using B/M/V with structurally consistent topology is expected supported; metadata extensions are warnings.
A frame declaring 3D or vertices with three coordinates is expected unsupported; F assignments remain warnings and do not decide the class.

Prior diagnostic outcomes do not automatically rewrite the frozen expected classification. The coordinator-authorized oriedita-08 correction is recorded explicitly, is supported by raw-geometry evidence, and changes no product threshold.

The acceptance diagnostic had already run, so this tranche is not blind in the sense tranche 1 was; each entry's basis names the raw fact that decides it, so the classification can be re-derived without any runtime result.
